paras: Cnemaspis jacobsoni is a species of gecko, a lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is native to Indonesia.
The specific name, jacobsoni, is in honor of Dutch naturalist Edward Richard Jacobson (1870–1944).
C. jacobsoni is endemic to the island of Simeulue, Indonesia.
The preferred natural habitat of C. jacobsoni is forest.
Small for its genus, C. jacobsoni may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 3 cm (1.2 in). Males have neither femoral pores nor preanal pores.
